item.title: Railway Says Intruder May Have Accessed Customer Secrets, Urges Credential Rotation
item.description: Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) provider Railway on Wednesday disclosed "anomalous activity" related to systems that store customer environment variables. Upon further investigation, the company found that an unauthorized third party may have gained access to encrypted environment variables, and, in some cases, obtained the decrypted contents.

item.title: Synthetic unrelated item: patch round-up for a desktop browser
item.description: A browser vendor shipped fixes for several memory-safety bugs. Users should update.
